info.title: fleett API
info.description: Control plane for fleet-managed Hermes agents. Every /api route except GET /api/health, GET /api/auth/config and GET /api/openapi.json requires a bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) or a fleett_session cookie. Mutations require the admin role. Browser-facing /auth/login, /auth/callback and /auth/logout are outside /api and are intentionally omitted from this document. GET /api/openapi.json is authoritative: its info.version is the binary version and a unit test fails the build when a router route is missing from this document (or documented but absent from the router).

patch.summary: Select the provider the assistant borrows
patch.description: Admin only. Stores the selection (settings.assistant_provider) and returns the freshly resolved configuration. FLEETT_ASSISTANT_PROVIDER still wins; provider_source reports the winner.

bearerAuth.description: FLEETT_TOKEN or a named API token

BadRequest.description: Malformed request: invalid JSON, query parameter or path

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid bearer token / session cookie

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the role does not allow this action

NotFound.description: The instance, resource or route does not exist

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state (duplicate id, running job, ...)

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the route limit

UnprocessableEntity.description: The payload is syntactically valid but violates a policy or validation rule

TooManyRequests.description: A rate limit refused the call; retry later

BadGateway.description: An upstream service (marketplace, proxy, provider, webhook target) failed

provider.description: Resolved provider; null when nothing is resolved (see reason).

provider_source.description: Where the provider comes from: FLEETT_ASSISTANT_PROVIDER (env), the stored selection (setting), the single existing provider (auto), or nothing (none).

reason.description: Why no provider is resolved: no_provider (none exists) or not_selected (several exist, none selected). null when a provider is resolved.

link.description: Internal console route that repairs the check (e.g. /providers?assistant=1). fix stays the command form.

reason.description: Machine-readable cause of the line when the console branches on it (no_provider, not_selected).

EgressPolicyInput.description: Omitted fields keep their current value.

EnvInput.description: Either a list of `{key,value,secret}` entries (canonical) or a legacy `{KEY: value}` map.

ExecRequest.description: Either `cmd` (split on whitespace, no shell) or `argv`.

McpTool.description: One tool advertised by an MCP server; `input_schema` is the open JSON Schema sent by the server.

ScopeRequest.description: Body of the optional `scope` field of POST /api/tokens.

Skill.description: One published version of a skill.

token.description: Returned once, never stored in clear

TokenScope.description: Restricts a token to some instances and actions. Omitted: the global role applies.

has_secret.description: Always true; the secret itself is never returned

provider.description: Provider id the assistant must borrow, or null to clear the stored selection (auto takes over again).
